code_shape: aligned_with_ne12-prototype-v0.3 bureau_profiles items; NOT drop-in due loader schema and 12-bureau assertions
warnings: All baseline operational volumes, revenues, costs and unrepresented freight business values are fictional game calibration assumptions, not financial records.
Game initial year labels price index 2025=100; full conceptual railway network already operates at game start, irrespective of real opening dates.

Unrepresented freight receipts are net settlement allocations with costs outside the modeled bureau budget; the accounting assumption intentionally grants hidden business profit and should not be presented as real-world zero-cost physical shipping.
Dynamic hidden income uses each bureau freight_index / 100, with NO hard freight capacity cap and no bonus revenue in station revenue.
The base operating costs include the ordinary modeled transportation workload only and do not scale upward with off-map equivalent freight.
No capital expense, subsidy, debt, lobbying points, depreciation or fixed annual free productivity increase.
